native_source_policy: Every runtime512photo is a whole-photograph crop at least512px from newly generated native original. No runtime upscaling, face/body paste, facial warping, synthetic texture overlay or local beauty retouch. Lower images derive from RGB512master. Originals immutable under /workspace/generated_images. Synthetic small identity guides are not runtime images.
archived_note: Initial actual q80method6 atlas preflight from provisionalmethod0 candidate selection; failed cases retained. Final codec remains frozen; all candidate native masters reencoded consistently with same finalcodec and remeasured. No threshold or alignment changes.
